# `APPLY_IR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Apply (`APPLY_`)](README.md#domain-apply) |
| Reported by | `plugin` |

## What happened

The bundle's (or a DCR's) IR major is not supported by this plugin or CLI; nothing is applied.

## What to do

Update whichever side is older: the plugin, or the CLI (`npx @holotype/cli@latest`).
